items.title: Meta's stock drops on light revenue guidance, dwindling free cash flow
items.description: Meta issued a weaker-than-expected revenue forecast and narrowed its capex range for the year.

items.title: Microsoft beats Q4 cloud expectations as full-year Azure revenue tops $100 billion
items.description: Microsoft's backlog sat 8% taller than the previous quarter, mainly thanks to contributions from customers other than large artificial intelligence companies.

items.title: Sam Altman to meet with White House's Wiles this week ahead of AI framework deadline
items.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman is meeting with a range of senior Trump administration officials, lawmakers and economists.

items.title: Carvana stock falls 15% as auto retailer's 2026 earnings guidance misses Wall Street's expectations
items.description: Carvana said Wednesday it expects earnings of between $2.7 billion and $3 billion this year after reporting record quarterly results for the second quarter.

items.title: Hims and Hers shares fall 10% as FTC sues company over data, billing practices
items.description: The FTC sued Hims and Hers over alleged health data sharing with Meta and Snap, billing practices and subscription cancellations.

items.title: Starbucks stock jumps as coffee giant raises full-year outlook
items.description: Starbucks posted its fourth straight quarter of same-store sales growth, as it continues a turnaround under CEO Brian Niccol.

items.title: Jeffrey Gundlach says the bond market is telling Warsh the Fed has to start acting on inflation
items.description: Gundlach said the divergent moves across the Treasury curve showed investors' skepticism that the Fed will ultimately follow through.

items.title: Chipotle hikes same-store sales forecast as diners return for burrito bowls
items.description: Chipotle Mexican Grill stock has fallen more than 7% this year, dragging its market value down to roughly $44 billion.

items.title: Qualcomm to raise prices during memory crunch as chipmaker issues light earnings guidance
items.description: "Cost went up, prices are going to go up," Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon said in an interview.

items.title: Todd Blanche attorney general nomination on edge as Cornyn questions Trump-IRS settlement
items.description: Sen. John Cornyn says the DOJ has failed to satisfy his concerns about a deal to shield President Donald Trump and others from IRS tax audits.

items.title: Secret Service 'illegally' surveilled Comey in Trump ‘8647’ threat case: Court filing
items.description: Ex-FBI Director James Comey says he's the subject of vindictive prosecution for posting on Instagram a photo of seashells forming the numbers "8647."

items.title: Fed keeps rates steady. The big question now: What will Microsoft and Meta say on AI capex?
items.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

items.title: Brent oil jumps back above $90 after Trump threatens to hit Iran hard
items.description: Oil rose sharply amid renewed tensions in the Middle East after Iran launched an attack on U.S. forces using ballistic missiles.

items.title: Divided Fed holds interest rates steady, but three members voted to hike
items.description: Despite increasing support for a rate increase, the Federal Open Market Committee voted 9-3 to leave the federal funds rate in a range between 3.5% and 3.75%.

items.title: Apple shares just hit a record. Here's how trader Mike Khouw is playing the move
items.description: Even as broader tech names and momentum plays have faltered, Apple has hit new all-time highs.

items.title: Elon Musk's xAI sues Minnesota over law to ban 'nudify' apps
items.description: Elon Musk's xAI, now owned by SpaceX, is challenging a law that would ban so-called nudify apps in Minnesota

items.title: Humana tops quarterly estimates, maintains profit outlook as medical costs stay in line
items.description: Humana maintained its 2026 adjusted profit outlook of at least $9 per share, which some analysts called a "disappointment" amid high expectations for insurers.

items.title: How a 40-year-old father launched a $1.6 billion-a-year meat snacks empire from a bankrupt Wisconsin business
items.description: Jack Link turned a bankruptcy into an opportunity to build a beef jerky empire. Four decades later, Link Snacks brings in more than $1 billion in annual sales.

items.title: Warren, Schiff urge SEC to probe Trump Media's paid service giving faster access to Trump's posts
items.description: Trump has frequently posted policy announcements or other newsworthy information on Truth Social that have sent global markets hurtling up or down.

items.title: YES Network, MSG Networks to exit Gotham app for DAZN streaming service
items.description: The regional sports networks that air games for local New York and New Jersey teams, including MLB's Yankees and NHL's Rangers, will have a new streaming home.
